summary: Master tourism and hospitality data analytics. Learn revenue management, demand forecasting, and guest sentiment analysis to drive growth. Enroll today.
lede: Data Analytics in Tourism and Hospitality helps professionals turn fragmented travel and lodging data into actionable insight. This course develops practical skills in demand forecasting, dynamic pricing, guest behavior modeling, sentiment analysis, and marketing attribution. You will work with data from property management systems, distribution systems, online travel agencies, and CRM platforms to support operational decisions. Across five days, you will build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, calculate Customer Lifetime Value, apply Net Promoter Score analytics, and present findings to stakeholders with a focus on ROI and risk mitigation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for mid-to-senior level professionals who manage data-driven functions within the travel, tourism, and lodging sectors.
audience: Tourism Data Analysts focused on destination
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of hospitality KPIs (RevPAR, ADR) and basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Experience working with a Property Management System (PMS) or Revenue Management System (RMS) is recommended but not required.
